insert into [dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_EcnTradeBlotter_Inventories]
select distinct INV, 1 as [IG_PIVOT], 0 as [HY_PIVOT], getdate() as [rowCreateDate]
from (select left(Inventory,4) as INV from [dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_EcnTradeBlotter1a]) A
left join [dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_EcnTradeBlotter_Inventories] B on A.INV = B.Inventory
where A.INV is null

update [dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_EcnTradeBlotter3a]
set 
RangeValue = B.RangeValue
from [dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_EcnTradeBlotter3a] A
left join [dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_EcnTradeBlotter3b] B on 
A.Inventory = b.Inventory and A.RangeGroup = B.RangeGroup and A.origin = b.origin
SELECT top 1 concat('ECN CAT BLOTTER_',year([Trade_Date]),'-',month([Trade_Date]),'-',day([Trade_Date])) as archiveFileName FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_EcnTradeBlotter1a]
